name: Beach Cleanups
about: Volunteer beach clean-ups along Jumeirah and the Marina, with gloves, bags and coffee afterwards. Every bag counts.

stories.author: p10
stories.text: Kite Beach clean-up: 14 bags, 3 lost sunglasses and one very confused crab.

stories.author: p05
stories.text: Puppy watched the team from the water's edge. Very good boy.

stories.author: p08
stories.text: Coffee urn at the clean-up, the best reward for the volunteers. Thank you all.

posts.author: p10
posts.text: Saturday clean-up at Kite Beach, meeting 6:30am at the lifeguard tower. Gloves and bags provided, but bring water and a hat. We finish by 8:30 before the heat.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Count me in, I'll run to the beach and then join the crew. Early start is my favourite.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: I'll bring the bike and a trailer for the full bags. Easier to carry them back.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Gloves and bags are provided, great. I'll bring my friend who wants to volunteer for the first time.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Coffee for the crew after, I'm baking the cupcakes now. Count me in for the morning.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Puppy wants to help, but the beach is a no-dog zone for the clean-up. He'll cheer from the car.

comments.author: p06

comments.author: p03

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Thanks for the tips, everyone. I'll bring the sunscreen, the water and the good mood.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Bring a small bag for your own rubbish too. Every little bag is a win for the beach.

comments.author: p05

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Good point, Mariam. Dog walkers should clear up after their dogs, always.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: We'll bring the sorting boxes for plastic, glass and cans. Sort at the beach if you can.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Sorting at the beach saves time for the team at the end. Smart plan, Hannah.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Cupcakes, coffee and gloves. The perfect volunteer breakfast, I'm sure.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Count me in. Looking forward to a clean beach and a happy crew.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Yalla, clean beach Saturday. See you at the lifeguard tower at 6:30 🌊

posts.author: p05

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Thank you, Mariam. A dog bag on the walk is the simplest way to help the beach.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Dog owners who clean up after their pets are real heroes of the beach. Respect.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: A separate bag for dog waste is a smart tip. Keeps the rest of the rubbish clean.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Puppy on a lead near the crew is very wise. Pastry bags are handy too, for the sticky stuff.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Lead for the puppy, bags for the mess, and a treat for the good behaviour. Clear rules.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Clean-up teams really appreciate it when dog walkers help. Let's make that normal.

comments.author: p08

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pastry and puppy-friendly beaches, a dream combination. Thank you, Mariam.

comments.text: Keep the stats honest and simple, the volunteers feel the progress that way.

comments.author: p10

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Record-breaking is the goal for next time. Team Hannah is in.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Let's beat the 42. Yalla, the crew is growing every month 🌊

comments.text: Pastries for the record-breakers. A little motivation never hurt anyone.

comments.author: p10

comments.text: Thanks all. I'll bring the tokens and the washing station for the next clean-up.

comments.text: Yes. Thank you all for the support. The cups are coming to the next beach day.

comments.text: Coffee in reusable cups on a clean beach. The best possible Saturday.

comments.author: p04

posts.text: Music at the beach clean-up: a small speaker with a playlist kept the volunteers going for two hours. Keep the volume low, of course, so the birds and neighbours stay happy.

comments.text: Music, sunshine, and a clean beach. A lovely way to spend a Saturday.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Great, the more the merrier. Yalla, dance break on the sand 🎶

posts.author: p04

comments.text: Ride and run to the beach, my favourite combo. Count me in for the next clean-up.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Riding with the bags on the handlebars is a good workout too. Respect, Tomasz.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Cold drink at the end, yes, I'll bring the cold brew for the riders. Deal.

posts.author: p07
posts.text: Clean-up volunteers: please report any injured wildlife to the lifeguards or the environment hotline, do not try to move turtles or birds yourself. Quick, calm, and safe.

comments.author: p10
comments.text: Very important, Anjali. Always call the professionals for injured wildlife, and keep distance.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: Vet nurse here: animals in pain can bite even if they look calm. Stay back and call for help.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Keep the dogs on the leash near the nesting areas too. Wildlife deserves the space.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: A running route near the nesting area should avoid the sand zone during the season. Good to know.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: Coffee shops also see the injured birds sometimes. The staff know who to call.

comments.author: p03
comments.text: Pastry chef-level precision is not needed for wildlife rescue. Please leave it to the experts.

comments.author: p06
